# The files whose change can change the pictures of scripts/screenshots.sh, one
# pattern on each line, as the paths of a workflow: * stays within a folder, **
# goes through folders. After a change of main that touches one of them, the
# screenshot bot renders the pictures anew; scripts/screenshots.sh and this list
# count always. The bot also renders every week, after every release and on demand,
# which brings a new social preview of a project and a new version of a tool.
#
# The cards of the home page: their list, the script that makes their pictures and
# the page from which it draws those of the languages after the first. The pictures
# themselves are left out, so that the merge of the bot's own pull request starts
# no run.
projects.toml
scripts/project-pictures.sh
.github/card-picture.html
# The website as the pictures of the READMEs and of the About pages show it: the
# script that drives the browser, the home pages and the Trust page, their
# templates, their look, the logo and the hooks that write the groups, the cards,
# the guarantees and the search of every project.
scripts/screenshots.py
docs/index*.md
docs/trust.md
docs/assets/**
docs/stylesheets/**
docs/javascripts/**
overrides/**
mkdocs.yml
.github/mkdocs_project.py
.github/mkdocs_blueprint.py
.github/mkdocs-blueprint.yml
